phrase: proceed cautiously, yielding to vehicles not so obligated to stop or yield and which are within the intersection or approaching so closely as to constitute an immediate hazard during the time such driver is moving across or within the intersection
note: The exact law supplies no numeric immediate-hazard or due-caution cutoff.
